identity.description: suid3num enumerates SUID binaries and auto-suggests GTFOBins privilege-escalation paths. The tool is delivered through the Cortex POV payload shelf (sha256-pinned 25a070b7756010f5…, staged to /tmp/suid3num.py) rather than an ad-hoc internet download, so it survives default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of suid3num and its artifacts.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid

payload.code:
# MATURE: suid3num deployed via adapter_ref TOOL-SUID3NUM + payload shelf.
[ -s /tmp/suid3num.py ] || { echo '[FATAL] PAYLOAD_NOT_STAGED_ON_TARGET:/tmp/suid3num.py — TTP did NOT run; absent detections are NOT a Cortex miss' >&2; exit 1; }
sha256sum /tmp/suid3num.py
python3 /tmp/suid3num.py -e

expected_artifacts.description: suid3num executed by a service account.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suid3num Executed by a Service Account on the Endpoint
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs suid3num — an offensive TOOL-SUID3NUM-wired tool not part of normal operations on this host.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "/tmp/suid3num.py" or action_process_command_line contains "suid3num"
| comp count() as runs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter runs >= 1

abiocs.name: First-Seen Execution of suid3num on This Host
abiocs.description: A host that has never run suid3num executes it shortly after it is staged/installed — the deploy-then-run chain of an offensive tool.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "suid3num"
| comp count() as first_runs by agent_hostname
abiocs.causality_anchor: adapter deploy/stage of suid3num -> first execution by a service-account shell
